- Added a full Achievements system: unlock badges across many categories (wins, formats, streaks, social play, and more), viewable from a new Achievements page.
- Achievement unlocks now show a toast notification and a badge indicator on the Achievements button, plus an option to hide already-unlocked achievements.
- The "Completionist" meta-achievement (unlock every other achievement) now has its own exclusive Diamond tier, distinct from ordinary Platinum-tier achievements.
- Each player's name on the game board now shows a trophy icon colored by their highest unlocked achievement tier.
- Rotisserie Draft creators can now randomize the pool and choose how large the randomized sample is.
- Fixed match-level achievements (Match Point, Comeback Kid, etc.) so they correctly trigger for draft-based matches, not just head-to-head games.
- Fixed time-of-day achievements (Night Owl, Early Bird, Marathon Session) to use each player's own local time zone instead of the server's.
- Fixed a bug where a rejected card play could leave the board showing stale information until the page was manually refreshed.
- Fixed a rules bug where a nested Creativity-copy could show incorrect simulated values.
- Added new Steampunk, Futuristic, and Neon card skin art for Anger.
